title: Pizzadilla (Grilled Pizza Sandwich)
description: This pizzadilla (grilled pizza sandwich) recipe is a riff on a Papadia. Chef John uses prepared pizza dough and sauce, sausage, mushrooms, and mozzarella.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil, divided, or as needed
0.5 cup cooked Italian sausage, or to taste
0.5 cup cooked mushrooms, or to taste
0.5 cup cooked red onions, or to taste

steps.text: Divide dough into 4 equal pieces. Roll each piece into a 1/8-inch-thick circle on a lightly floured surface.

Heat a skillet over medium-high heat; brush with oil. Add 1 dough piece; reduce heat to medium. Cook for 2 minutes; flip. Spread 1/4 cup sauce over dough, leaving about 1/2 inch edge; sprinkle 1/4 mozzarella cheese on top sauce. Top half of cheese with 1/4 each sausage, mushrooms, and red onion. Press gently in middle of dough with a spatula to make a crease; fold in half.
Brush top crust with olive oil; flip. Repeat on other side. Continue cooking until both sides reach desired browning and crispness.
Repeat with remaining pizza dough and toppings. Cut each pizzadilla in half and serve.
